Senior Network Engineer - (B2B) 
 Location: Remote (Romania)
 Contract: B2B / Freelance, 12 months with intent to extend
 Rate: €300–€340 per day , dependent on experience
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with strong SD-WAN experience to join a global Enterprise Data Centre and Network organisation. You will support the deployment and operation of campus SD-WAN and backbone network services across enterprise sites and data centres.
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Deploy, migrate and operate SD-WAN and WAN infrastructure across campus and data centre environments, preferably Cisco Viptela and/or Juniper SD-WAN.
 - Transition legacy WAN networks to software defined models using SDN, automation and orchestration.
 - Integrate the SD-WAN edge with campus LAN and data centre routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VRF segmentation, high availability).
 - Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize SD-WAN performance, including latency, loss, jitter, application aware routing and QoS.
 - Work with cross domain teams on DNS, routing, security controls and coordinated change execution.
 - Create runbooks, templates and operational documentation.
 - Support incident, problem and change processes, and coordinate with carriers and vendors on circuit turn ups, migrations and cutovers.
 Requirements 
 - Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of relevant IT infrastructure experience.
 - 5+ years of network, WAN or SD-WAN engineering experience in enterprise scale routed networks.
 - 3+ years of hands on SD-WAN implementation experience, preferably Cisco Viptela and/or Juniper SD-WAN, including policy design, segmentation and template driven configuration.
 - Strong routing and troubleshooting skills across OSI layers, including BGP, OSPF, VRF, NAT, DHCP and DNS.
 - Experience integrating SD-WAN edge platforms with campus LAN and data centre environments, including resiliency design.
 - Working knowledge of SD-WAN controller and management plane concepts, centralised provisioning and monitoring.
 Nice to Have 
 - Cisco Viptela experience, including vManage, templates and platform upgrades.
 - Experience executing large scale network migrations and cutovers, including hypercare.
 - Knowledge of carrier circuit delivery and vendor coordination.
 - Experience working within a formal service management framework (incident, change and problem management).
 - Strong stakeholder engagement skills across technical and non technical teams.
